scope: 270 displayed Chinese/English station label groups, including Hanghai Intercity and planned Tangjiacun; East Railway physical station parts share one displayed label
reviewMethod: All station labels reviewed in nine native Edge SVG contact sheets; Canvas actualBoundingBox ink measurements across all text rows; transport badge bounding boxes checked against all station symbol bounds and station text ink
principle: Keep captions close to their station. Moderate track overlap is allowed when the white halo maintains readability; do not move captions far away merely to avoid tracks.

verification.limits: 390px browser viewport verifies responsive layout, not physical-device gesture behavior. Ink-box checks do not prohibit intentional track intersections or prove every glyph is readable at every zoom.
